data.reason: The review at note 36 returns the ticket on F1 and F2. F1: the only channel a returning round's findings reach the window through is optional, and an omission writes an unattributable row that the verdict counts neither way, so the window reads clean. Taken by requiring a return from review to declare itself, and by holding the verdict at stay-shadow while anything in the window is unattributable, which is the rule as it was written rather than a new one. F2: four printed instructions still send the founder to flip one line while the harness demands two. F3 to F8 are taken in the same attempt: a voided receipt is not a delivery, the routes report the window their rates came from, the earliest round's triage is what a repeated finding is charged to and a test now says so, a damaged journal elsewhere no longer refuses this ticket's review, criterion 1 is marked as amended, and the sentence starts with a capital.
